scope: Analyze the correct reference before checking. Only arithmetic on saved native iteration24 records; no native single deletion, model, DT, GPU or training mutation.
accepted_PLAN: experiments/rl/PLAN.md: d_i is the factual-minus-single-EOS-deletion log ratio, while the native finite runner returns a joint all-source contrast allocation used as its estimate.

finite_runner_numerical_consistency.reason: Exactly the same two endpoints, target, weights and finite attribution contract.
finite_runner_numerical_consistency.limitation: This checks aggregate numerical consistency, not each token estimate, legal per-token probabilities, policy-gradient unbiasedness or task quality.

RL_per_token_estimator.reason: PLAN explicitly assigns each token a single-deletion d_i; the model must compute the numerator independently of c_i.
RL_per_token_estimator.limitation: Single-deletion values are a direct reference for the chosen fixed-history model intervention, not a mathematical identity defining joint finite allocations, nor an independently validated full environment causal effect.

finite_single_changed_pair.reference: Use the existing runner on x_only_i_EOS versus x_factual; only embedding i changes, so its single nonzero contribution should match that pair native endpoint score difference.
finite_single_changed_pair.discrimination: Joint c_i versus native single deletion tests the joint-to-single estimate. Finite single-pair c_i versus its own native endpoint difference tests finite propagation numerical consistency. Neither comparison is replaced by a one-update quality score.
finite_single_changed_pair.implementation: Reuse existing trace_token_attribution/PackedAnswerTargets/runner.attribute; no new probability head, softmax, model or finite implementation.
finite_single_changed_pair.execution_status: Not executed. Historical theta23/per-layer state absent, no new GPU diagnosis launched.

incident_same_endpoint_comparison.numerical_scope: Exponentials are FP64 calculations from saved FP32-logsoftmax/FP64-reduction records, not claims of exact model probabilities. Log-domain comparison is primary; FP32 exponentiation of this joint ratio would underflow.
incident_same_endpoint_comparison.interpretation: These are joint all-source quantities. The observed difference neither measures the pointwise single-delete error nor locates the -11.873 coefficient source. No arbitrary acceptance tolerance or passed label assigned.

future_reference_requirements: Same original theta, input token IDs, target labels/offsets and observation/policy masks.
Only source token i is replaced with the original EOS token; no physical sequence shortening, re-tokenization or target re-selection.
Reuse native owner endpoint likelihood and original dtype/cache interfaces; record actual imported paths/SHA and any layout differences.
A future or checkpoint25/current-weight measurement must be explicitly labeled a different fixed-point experiment, never a replay of iteration24.
